title: Patient Financial Responsibility Terms under Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
These terms describe, payer class by payer class, what a patient of Halverson Clinical Laboratories may owe once a health plan held under **Insurance Coverage & Claims** has processed a claim.

## Terms by payer class

| Payer class | Patient owes deductible, coinsurance or copay on covered clinical laboratory tests | Patient owes deductible or coinsurance on covered anatomic pathology services | Nothing beyond a plan copay may be billed for services the plan covers | Patient may be billed the difference between billed charges and the payer's payment | Cap on what an out-of-network patient is billed after the payer pays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | No | Yes | No | No | Not applicable |
| Medicare Advantage Plan | Yes | Yes | No | No | Not applicable |
| Medicare Supplement Plan | No | No | No | No | Not applicable |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan | No | No | Yes | No | Not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime and Select | Yes | Yes | No | No | Not applicable |
| Commercial In-Network Plan | Yes | Yes | No | No | Not applicable |
| Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Self-pay price |

## Terms explained

1. **Cost share on clinical laboratory tests.** Where the term reads "No", the patient owes no deductible, coinsurance or copay on covered clinical laboratory tests under that payer class.
2. **Cost share on anatomic pathology.** Where the term reads "Yes", the patient may owe deductible or coinsurance on covered anatomic pathology services.
3. **Copay-only billing.** Under Medicaid Managed Care Plan, the laboratory may not bill the patient anything beyond a plan copay for services the plan covers.
4. **Balance billing and its cap.** Only under the Commercial Out-of-Network Plan may the patient be billed the difference between billed charges and the payer's payment. That balance is capped at the sum of the self-pay prices of the order's tests.

## Questions a patient may put

- *My plan is Original Medicare Part B. Do I owe coinsurance on a covered blood test?* No: clinical laboratory tests carry no patient cost share under that payer class; anatomic pathology services do.
- *My plan is out of network. Can I be billed more than the self-pay price of my tests after the plan pays?* No: the balance is capped at the sum of the self-pay prices of the order's tests.
